do.text: Set `type`, `inputMode` and `autoComplete` for the value's kind, so phones show the keys people need and browsers can fill it in.

dont.text: Don't leave an email field as plain text: phones capitalise it and hide the @ key, and autofill cannot help.

do.text: Keep the fields of one form in one look.

dont.text: Don't mix outlined, filled and underlined fields: the form reads as several.
